name: Dyna Brothers 1 + 2
author: MatyMeatBoy
blurb: Experimental native Windows runners for Dyna Brothers and Dyna Brothers 2 Special, with partial English translations.
description:
Dyna Brothers 1 + 2 is a development project for native Windows execution of Dyna Brothers and Dyna Brothers 2 Special for Sega Mega Drive / Genesis. The current AOT runners execute statically emitted 68000 operations with current-byte validation and no 68000 interpreter fallback in those targets. The Z80 sound CPU remains a separate interpreted component.

The public source includes hash-qualified input checks, guarded translation tooling and a shared launcher/language-selection foundation. Dyna Brothers 1 uses the supplied Tybis English base plus repaired map/surrender labels. Dyna Brothers 2 Special has a partial adaptation of 22 English gameplay prompts; the ordinary retail DB2 IPS is not compatible with Special.

This is unfinished development work, not a stable or complete port. Full translations, campaign coverage, sound/timing/color fidelity, physical controllers, true extended-world 16:9 and qualified AOT save-state/rewind support remain open. The currently published repository has no standalone release ZIP yet; checkpoint packaging is separate work in progress. Bring your own exact Japanese dumps; no ROMs or original extracted assets are distributed.
needs: Your own qualified Japanese Dyna Brothers 1 MiB dump and/or Dyna Brothers 2 Special Virtual Console 2.5 MiB dump.
setup_steps: This is currently a source-development project, without a published standalone release ZIP.
Follow the repository build instructions with Python, CMake, Ninja, SDL2 and a C/C++ toolchain.
Supply your own exact Japanese dumps.
Build DynaBrothers1AOT / DynaBrothers2AOT and use their launcher or documented development entry points.
credits: Maintained by MatyMeatBoy, using GenesisRecomp / m68k-recomp-core and their licenses, including PolyForm Noncommercial terms. DB1 English base by Tybis. DB2 prompt adaptation provenance is documented; the supplied retail IPS is not redistributed. Catalog dinosaur icon generated with AI.
notes: Source-development listing only until a qualified standalone checkpoint is publicly released. Do not advertise full English, 16:9 world extension, physical M30 acceptance, or working AOT savestates/rewind. Screenshot is an actual native development-runner tutorial.
